purpose: Operational routing directory for search, rescue, family tracing, consular verification and emergency medical escalation. Service entries are not person-status evidence by themselves.
rules: Use local emergency and government channels first for active rescue or immediate danger.
Do not send sensitive identity documents or private contact details to public channels unless the receiving service explicitly requires them.
Consular services verify and assist their nationals but do not replace Nepalese missing-person investigations.
Restoring Family Links and family-tracing services are separate from official missing-person status determination.
Any status received from a service must be recorded as a dated source claim with provenance rather than silently overwriting prior evidence.
